method: Batch 92 (mobrec92): the batch 91 b91mr harness whose loop also ticks the slimes and magma cubes a death spawns (World.updateEntities walks a growing list; each child gets a logging Entity.rand after its constructor, the constructor jump delay is the input in `kids`), row element 12 holds one row per child [x, y, z, health, target (1000 + child order), revenge, size, draws, motion]. Iron golem and player kills of slime and magma cube sizes 2 and 4. snow-*: a snow golem against a spider, silverfish, witch (its potions fly: row element 9 lists snowballs and potions together in launch order), size 2 slime and magma cube, and a cave spider; golem-blaze: an iron golem against a blaze.Unchanged classes on the VillageLiveProbe double (no village), the player a real EntityPlayerMP (ServerPlayerProbe), every mob ticked by Entity.onUpdate. Per tick: [mob rows [x,y,z,health,target index,revenge index,flags,draws], sounds, player health lost, player revenge index, player ticks]; the player has index types.length. See EndermanWolfProbe.java for types and script ops.
